principle: Synthetic data must enter as realistic raw-ish files and pass through the same ETL semantics as real data. The generator may know truth; ETL may not.

separate_rna_atac: non-paired cell/nucleus identifiers sharing donor labels

canonical_outputs: sparse matrices with explicit axis dictionaries
mandatory_invariants: row/column identity is explicit and SHA-bound
feature order cannot be inferred from shape
structural missingness never becomes measured zero
zero coverage and zero variance remain distinct
hg19/hg38 conversion is explicit and receipted
ambiguous identifiers remain unresolved rather than guessed
donor/cell identities are not reconstructed from row order
no protected/hidden truth field is available to ETL logic
synthetic provenance cannot bypass production validation gates

acceptance.SMALL_CI: exact where deterministic; every planted corruption either corrected by an explicitly qualified transform or fails closed
acceptance.FULL104_SCALE: same ETL code path and schemas; no scale-specific scientific shortcuts

forbidden: generating already-clean canonical matrices as the only synthetic input
letting the ETL read truth manifests
special-casing synthetic files to skip validation
using downstream model success to judge ETL correctness
